title: Counter
description: Stateful counter used to explore framework-independent item models and action-driven state updates.

count.description: Current count value managed by the item model.

initialCount.description: Count used when the item model reset action is called.

reset.title: Reset
reset.description: Resets the count to the initial count.

stateChanged.title: State Changed
stateChanged.description: Emitted when the counter model state changes.
